reason: User input flows directly through multiple transformations (StringBuilder manipulation, Base64 encode/decode, substring, split) to Thing2.doSomething which constructs a StringBuilder containing the processed input and writes it via PrintWriter. The chain lacks effective neutralization; while obfuscation techniques exist, they do not prevent XSS execution on arbitrary input reaching the sink.
